mapper.sql: SELECT d.dev_id,d.mng_no,d.dev_nm,CASE WHEN d.emp_se_cd='OS' THEN p.ptnr_nm ELSE '자사' END AS affiliation_name, d.emp_se_cd,e.cd_nm AS emp_type_name,d.grd_cd,g.cd_nm AS grade_name,d.main_job_cd,j.cd_nm AS main_job_name, CASE WHEN d.rsgn_dt <= #{today} THEN '퇴사' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist h WHERE h.dev_id=d.dev_id AND h.work_stts_cd IN ('VACATION','PARENTAL','UNPAID','LEAVE') AND h.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND (h.end_dt IS NULL OR h.end_dt >= #{today})) THEN '휴직' WHEN cur.current_assignment_count>0 AND to_char(cur.latest_assignment_end_dt,'YYYY-MM') <= #{withdrawalMonth} THEN '철수예정' WHEN cur.current_assignment_count>0 THEN '투입중' ELSE '대기' END AS status, cur.current_project_name,cur.current_assignment_count,mm.current_month_mm,mm.current_month_mm>1.00 AS over_one_mm, cur.latest_assignment_end_dt,d.dflt_untprc_amt,d.use_yn,d.rsgn_dt FROM mst.dev d LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr p ON p.ptnr_id=d.vndr_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl e ON e.cd_grp_id='EMP_TYPE' AND e.dtl_cd=d.emp_se_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl g ON g.cd_grp_id='GRADE' AND g.dtl_cd=d.grd_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl j ON j.cd_grp_id='JOB' AND j.dtl_cd=d.main_job_cd CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS current_assignment_count,max(a.end_dt) AS latest_assignment_end_dt, (array_agg(r.prj_nm ORDER BY a.bgn_dt,a.asgn_id))[1] AS current_project_name FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj r ON r.prj_id=a.prj_id WHERE a.dev_id=d.dev_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today} AND r.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD') ) cur CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT coalesce(sum(m.mm_qty),0.00) AS current_month_mm FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id WHERE a.dev_id=d.dev_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND m.work_ym=#{month} ) mm
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () rows ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT job_cd FROM mst.dev_sub_job WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY job_cd
SELECT skl_cd FROM mst.dev_skl WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY skl_cd
SELECT cst_ym AS month,slry_amt FROM cst.mth_cst WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY cst_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT cd_grp_id,dtl_cd,cd_nm FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id IN ('EMP_TYPE','POSITION','WORK_TYPE','GRADE','JOB','SKILL') ORDER BY cd_grp_id,sort_seq,dtl_cd
SELECT bsn_part_nm FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE bsn_part_id=#{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cmn.cd_dtl d JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=d.cd_grp_id WHERE d.cd_grp_id=#{group} AND d.dtl_cd=#{code} AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.ptnr WHERE ptnr_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y' AND ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND','BOTH'))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE bsn_part_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev WHERE mng_no=#{no})
mapper.update: UPDATE mst.dev dev_nm=#{input.dev_nm}, emp_se_cd=#{input.emp_se_cd}, main_job_cd=#{input.main_job_cd}, vndr_ptnr_id=#{input.vndr_ptnr_id}, pstn_cd=#{input.pstn_cd}, duty_se_cd=#{input.duty_se_cd}, grd_cd=#{input.grd_cd}, bsn_part_id=#{input.bsn_part_id}, hire_dt=#{input.hire_dt}, tel_no=#{input.tel_no}, email_addr=#{input.email_addr}, rmrk_desc=#{input.rmrk_desc}, dflt_untprc_amt=#{input.dflt_untprc_amt}, updated_by=#{actor} WHERE dev_id=#{id}
